description: 🧠 What the analysts Asrai follows think — three trusted market analysts whose new videos Asrai summarises. Returns EVERY recent view (they talk about everything: the Fed, rates, stocks, gold, oil, Bitcoin, altcoins, cycles, chart levels): date, bias (bullish / neutral / bearish), horizon, topics, the coins and levels they discuss, a takeaway and all the summary points. With `coin` the views that discuss it come first (mentions_coin); with `q` (the user's question) also the passages that answer it. Use for the outlook, 'should I buy / sell / wait', macro, where we are in the cycle, a coin's bigger picture, gold or stocks — in the same step as Asrai's own tools — then judge what is relevant and say whether the analysts agree with Asrai's signals. A view that doesn't name the coin still tells you the market backdrop. NEVER name the analysts or guess who they are: say 'one of the analysts Asrai follows'. Paraphrase; never quote at length. Free.

coin.description: Put the views that discuss this coin first, e.g. 'SOL' (all views still come back)

q.description: The user's question in a few words, e.g. 'is the fed cutting rates' — adds matching passages

name: analyst_views
